maddeler.e:
استرحموا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْحَمُوا (istarḥamū) /is.tar.ħa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# اُسْتُرْحِمُوا (usturḥimū) /us.tur.ħi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# اِسْتَرْحِمُوا (istarḥimū) /is.tar.ħi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
